# mobius-gateway 0.17.2

Adds the A2Agent provider with `A2AGENT_API_KEY` authentication and the existing shared Responses transport. Provider credentials remain hidden from sandbox commands.

Requires protocol **100**, configuration **30**, and framework **0.17.2**. No configuration change is needed from 0.17.1. For 0.16.50 installations, follow the [offline upgrade instructions](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/releases/tag/mobius-gateway-v0.17.1), preserving usage, pairing identity and all gateway state.
